description: Audits recent agent activity against policy rules and flags violations. Returns compliant vs flagged counts and report evidence; any storage CID is an anchor reference until provider readback/content match is separately verified.

period.description: Time period to audit: '24h', '7d', '30d'. Defaults to '7d'.

policy_id.description: Optional specific policy version to audit against, e.g. 'policy_v12'. Defaults to current.

name: yax_audit_compliance

compliant_runs.description: Number of runs that passed policy.

flagged_runs.description: Number of runs that violated policy.

report_cid.description: Optional Filecoin CID reference for the compliance report; verify by provider readback before calling it anchored.

violations.description: Details of each policy violation: run_id, rule, severity.
